books.note: kavi/lekhak parichay + path-vyakhya nodes (Sohanlal Dwivedi, Dhyan Chand, Premchand, Rahim, Surdas...); no vyaakaran teaching
01 sunna-bolna, 02 pathan, 03 sangya (pad-bhed start: sangya bhed, paryayvachi, vilom, kaarak start)
Maithili Sharan Gupt, hariodh, Giridhar kavirai, Meera...; literature only

03 pad-bhed aur vaakya-samrachana is the class-7 grammar core: pad-bhed, uddeyshya-vidhey, mel-niyam, kaarak-chinh, shabd-bhandar (paryayvachi/vilom/ek shabd/muhaavara-lokokti), upasarg-pratyay (cheel-chaal)
Bharatendu, Dushyant Kumar, Mahadevi Verma, Bheeshm Sahni...; literature only
03 shabd-vichaar: tatsam-tadbhav rules, ruddhi/yogik/yogruddhi, upasarg-pratyay, pad-vichaar (kaarak 8 bhed, ling-vachan), kriya-kaal-vaachya-avyay-vaakya bhed, viraam-chinh, muhaavare

books.book: c9_hin_ga_cbse (the single Class-9 Hindi book, per the 26-27 syllabus)
books.note: gadya (Premchand, Bakhshi, Renu...) + padya (Raidas, Tulsidas ke dohe, Nirala ke pad, Jhansi ki Rani, Vyaktitva ka saundarya); lokokti/muhaavara appear inside gadya contexts (ch02)
04 bhaasha is the grammar core: 'ne' two-condition rule, vishay-kriya mel, kaal identify/convert, viraam-chinh, alankaar kasauti (upama/roopak/atishayokti/anupraasa/yamak), muhaavare-lokoktiyan
ch01 (corpus title 'मुहावरे') carries the alankaar/chhand/muhaavara teaching: anupraasa-vs-yamak (kank-kank/soor-soor), upama (das been), laghu-guru matra rules, nakk-katna
Parvat Pradesh me Paavas (anupraasa-rich), Kar chale hum fida, Aatmatran, Bade bhai sahab, Kaartus...; ch18 carries arth/muhaavara work

01 nibandh praroop, 02 patra-lekhan, 03 apathit gadyansh, 04 vyaakaran kaushal (pad-parichay, vaakya bhed, kaal, vaachya, viraam-chinh, muhaavare-lokokti, vaakya-parivartan); 05-26 literature (Baath athanni ki...Saakhi, Girdhar ki kundaliyan, Megh aaye...)
01 Section-A bhaasha kaushal: sandhi (vidya+aalay deergh), samas (vidyaalay-praangan shashthi-tatpurush), upasarg-pratyay, vaakya-parivartan (vaachya), register; 02-05 literature
ch01 (corpus title 'विराम चिह्न') and ch06 carry the samas/padavali content (tatpurush, karmadharaya, bahuvrihi, avyayibhav hits)

01 khanda-A: vyaakaran (sandhi/samas/upasarg-pratyay/vaakya-shuddhi/viraam-chinh), rachna, apathit gadyansh; 02-12 literature (Mohan Rakesh, Jayshankar Prasad, Hazari Prasad Dwivedi, Mahadevi Verma, Dinkar, Nagarjun, Tulsidas)
